title: BPW-2026-0628
text:
[OTHER BOARD OFFICES]
BPW-2026-0628
CAO
CD 7
MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) – DISCOVERY CUBE LOS ANGELES (DCLA)
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE and FORWARD this report, with transmittal to the Mayor’s Office for approval to execute the proposed Amendment No. 5 to the Second MOU between the City of Los Angeles Department of Public Works, Bureau of Sanitation (BOS), and the DCLA for operational support and to develop, promote, and assist with the City of Los Angeles and Bureau of Sanitation environmental events and programs. The term of this Amendment No. 5 to the Second MOU will be increased in the maximum compensation by $1.8 million for the performance term of July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027;
AUTHORIZE the Office of the City Administrative Officer to continue to serve as administrator responsible for authorizing the disbursement of the cash advance and final approval of the invoice documentation, in accordance with the scope of services defined within the proposed Amendment No. 5 to the subject Second MOU, including the provision of other services mutually agreed upon by DCLA and BOS as part of a supplemental service schedule; and
UPON the Mayor’s authorization, the President or two members of the Board will execute the MOU.
